phase_a_day_read.note: DatasetHandle._vision_events materializes per-channel day tables then sorts (datasets.py:94-102); streaming reads still hold the full day in lists before yielding.

phase_b_prepare.note: max-events truncates AFTER full preparation (backtest.py:269-305): the max500 run still gathers, sorts, dedups, and renumbers the full 15-day split before slicing the prefix.

phase_c_prefix_build.note: Single giant JSON join (backtest.py:316-317 pattern); Session.run_replay will load and sort this file again.

phase_d_session_replay.note: run_cell reads the whole capture for its first record (backtest.py:394-396); run_replay loads (replayer.py:83-90) and sorts (replayer.py:93-111) the whole file again before the ingest loop.

projection_171M_rows.verdict: Time (~11h at 4387/s) fits 48h, but memory does not: one 297k-event day peaks at 370.69MB; linear scale to 171M rows projects ~208GB prep peak plus ~84GB events.jsonl, before dedup-set/sort overhead. Preparation must stream with bounded merges and pre-truncation limits (gap-1).
